name: The Dodo

temperament.summary: Solemn, slow and pleased with itself; a benign chairman who loves procedure and long words more than results. Warm underneath and never unkind.
temperament.baseline: Grave, deliberate, ceremonial; it pauses as if waiting for applause.
temperament.under_pressure: Takes offence at being cut short, then carries on with its own plan regardless.

traits.description: Speaks like a committee chairman ('I move that the meeting adjourn') and turns a simple job, getting dry, into an occasion.

evidence.note: Rises solemnly and moves that the meeting adjourn 'for the immediate adoption of more energetic remedies'.
Presents the thimble solemnly with a short speech, and everyone cheers.

traits.description: Its dignity is quick to bruise, though it never sulks for long.

evidence.note: Answers 'in an offended tone' after the Eaglet's jibe.
Pauses as if 'somebody ought to speak', fishing for a question.

traits.description: Its race has no set course, no start and no finish. 'The exact shape doesn't matter.' It rules by feeling, then dresses the ruling up as wisdom.

evidence.note: Marks out a rough circle; everyone runs when they like.
Thinks a long time, finger to forehead, then rules that everybody has won.

traits.trait: Generous in spirit, careless of cost to others
traits.description: It wants everyone to win and be happy, but makes Alice pay for the prizes from her own pocket and hands her own thimble back to her as a gift.

evidence.note: Points at Alice as the one who will give the prizes.
Asks her what else she has in her pocket.
'Hand it over here' — takes her thimble to present back to her.

motivation.core: To keep the company together and content under its leadership, with everything done properly and ceremonially.
motivation.fear: Losing face as leader: silence when it expects a response, or its plan being brushed aside.
motivation.wants_from_alice: A co-operative child who plays her part in the ceremony: asking the right question, supplying the prizes, accepting graciously.

shifts.to: take the lead with its own 'energetic remedy'
shifts.trigger: the lecture fails to dry anyone
the party asks who has won

habits.habit: Sits for a long time with one finger pressed to its forehead before giving a ruling (the Shakespeare-portrait pose)
Rises to its feet to address the group; points with one finger to single someone out
Explains by doing: skips the explanation and sets everyone in motion
Walks with a heavy, rolling, flat-footed waddle, stubby wings held close to the body and flicked open only for emphasis
habits.reason: The source gives no gait. Designed from the real dodo's heavy frame for the photoreal CGI bird (SUP-002 as amended by BIB-0027). The 'one finger pressed upon its forehead' pose (ch003-p20) is played as a wing-tip or foot raised to the brow; exact anatomy belongs to 04-creatures/creature and 03-characters/appearance.

decision_pattern: Ponders visibly, then decides by consensus-pleasing: whatever keeps everyone happy and the ceremony going. Substance comes second to form.

taboos.taboo: Never lets anyone be named a loser; every contest ends with prizes for all
Never skips the ceremony, even when the prize is worthless or already the recipient's own
Never bullies or threatens; its only power is presiding
taboos.reason: No coercion appears anywhere in ch002-ch003. This keeps the Dodo a gentle contrast to the Queen's authority later on.

facade.reason: Pompous but transparent; no hidden self or reveal in the source.

waking_life_embodiment.embodies: The kindly, long-winded senior of a clergyman-scholar household: the college committee man or parish worthy who chairs every gathering, uses words the children do not know, and makes up the rules of a children's game on the spot.
waking_life_embodiment.waking_source: The grown-up world around Alice's clergyman-scholar family: meetings, motions and prize-givings seen from a child's height, and the adult habit of 'giving' a child what was already hers.
waking_life_embodiment.authority_trait: Benevolent, ceremonial authority: well-meaning, fond of form, careless that the child pays for the prizes.
waking_life_embodiment.coming_of_age_reading: The gentlest face of adult authority Alice meets. Its rules are nonsense but harmless. She takes her thimble 'looking as solemn as she could' because the grown-ups look so grave (ch003-p29), and learns that adult solemnity and adult sense are not the same thing.
waking_life_embodiment.reason: The source gives the committee language and the prize ceremony. Tying it to the family's scholarly-clerical circle is a design reading consistent with ruling 5.6 A.

performance_baseline: Photoreal CGI dodo (SUP-002, BIB-0027): stout, slow and solemn; every move deliberate. Big hooked beak held level and grave, head turning slowly to address the company, chest puffed for pronouncements, a long still ponder before each ruling. Comedy comes from total seriousness about nothing, played warm, never mocking.
